name: 比尔·盖茨
bio_short: 美国商业大亨、软件工程师、慈善家。他与保罗·艾伦共同创立了微软，通过将MS-DOS授权给IBM及所有兼容机厂商，确立了软件行业的授权商业模式。他主导开发的Windows操作系统占据了全球桌面电脑的绝对统治地位，一手缔造了PC时代的“Wintel”联盟。
bio_short_en: American business magnate, software developer, and philanthropist. He co-founded Microsoft with Paul Allen and established the software licensing business model by licensing MS-DOS to IBM and all compatible manufacturers. The Windows operating system he championed achieved absolute dominance in the global desktop market, forging the 'Wintel' alliance of the PC era.
